data.name: Mother Modern Plumbing, Sewer & Drain Dallas, TX

reviews.text:
Mother’s came out to assess a sewer drainage leak that we had. Colton and his team were extremely helpful, and very knowledgeable.

They came to my house within 24 hours of me calling, and were incredibly thorough and fair. Steven and Colton were great, and the pricing was extremely transparent. I like the fact that everything was digital and emailed to me!

Fast forward, Jerry and Brian came out and completed the entire re-route in a week. They were thorough and updated us daily with their next

Totally happy with Colton and the proposals he gave us to resolve our problems. He explained the options and guarantees.
The workers were punctual and hard working. The broken pipe was very deep but the excavation crew exposed the broken pipe so Mathew could replace it. Once replaced and tested the excavation crew was back on the job within a few hours and everything was neat as a pin. Very satisfied and appreciative. Thanks for everything guys. Job very well done. Excellent job

We were in the midst of remodeling a bathroom when we ran into a problem which required some of the existing plumbing be replaced. We thought this might involve cutting out a piece of the wall behind the shower. Colton came and assessed the problem, got the required materials, and fixed it very quickly. He found a way to do it without cutting into the wall which we really liked!
Colton was professional, friendly, and did a great job!! We'll definitely call him again for our plumbing needs.

The reason for three stars is the cost point.
Matt and his apprentice that came out today and did the work were professional, knowledgeable and very nice. I was disappointed that it took two trips on two separate days to get the work done. That meant me missing two half days at work. Colton came out yesterday and was also very nice , but said he didn’t have the necessary parts with him to fix the leak. The guys today had to leave and go to the hardware store to get parts before they could get st

Mother Plumbing installed two toilets and three faucets for me two months ago. Since then, there have been no leaks or wobbles, which speaks to the quality of their work. Check out the picture of the wall mounted toilet.  They also coordinated well with my carpenters to get everything done efficiently and on schedule. I did forget to ask them to adjust the temperature governor on the shower, but overall, I’m very happy with the results. I highly recommend Mother Plumbing

I am very pleased with the service installed Tyler performed with my new faucet. He was very professional and educated me on the nice and necessary upgrade.  I highly recommend Tyler as well as the company where he works to be your next professional place of doing business.

Mother Modern’s customer service is second to none. Jesse in particular was phenomenal. From the moment he stepped through our door, he made us feel comfortable and at ease. He laid out his findings clearly, answered all of our questions, and gave us a complete understanding of the issues and potential paths forward. He made a tough day 10x better, and we were truly touched by his empathy and kindness. He even sent us cookies after he’d left to congratulate us on our new home. Safe to say Mother

We thought we had a main water leak from the street to the house and due to the thoroughness of the technition we found out it was only a sprinkler system issue. Josh was awesome in explaining everything and so thorough in his investigation we couldn't be happier with him and the outcome. Although we didn't need the repairs from them I would highly recommend Mother Modern Plumbing. A breath of fresh air with honesty and integrity!

Very good experience with Mother Modern Plumbing. Josh and his helper was very professional and did the job from 10 to almost 5. The rerouted my hot water pipings due to slab leak and replaced my 13 years old hot water heater with a new one with 12 years warranty. What was amazing was no jackhammer, no hole in the floor and only (minor) evidences of their great work was 2 small cutoff drywall.

They clean up all the mess and left the place better and cleaner than before.

Josh was able to quickly resolve my clogged drain issue just by running his camera line through my clean out. He also ran his camera through my other clean out. We were both able to see real time that there were no breaks in my cast-iron sewer  lines.  He answered all my questions about potential options in repairing my 47 year-old sewer line in the future.  Josh also took a look at a leaky shower handle. I had in my bathroom and gave me a recommendation on how I could fix it myself.  I highly r

I highly recommend Mother’s Modern Plumbing (ask for Dillon!) to anyone needing plumbing work — honest, skilled, and truly a pleasure to work with!

We recently had an issue with our outdoor faucet, and *Dillon Ashton* came to the rescue. From start to finish, the experience was exceptional. He was professional, punctual, and clearly knowledgeable. What really stood out was his communication — he explained the issue clearly, offered options **without pressure** and kept us informed every step of

Amazing service, professionalism, and price, considering what was accomplished . I wish I would have found them sooner! Master Josh was sent to us to diagnose and solve a troubling odd  plumbing problem! Shout out to Kyle and Gabriella. The team I dealt with start to finish. Call them if you want to be happy with results? I wish I could post a photo. For some reason it is not providing the option. Just imagine, visualize excellence. 😆

And Josh came out to my house and asked her plumber anyway my worst nightmares came to light it's an old house in Farmers Branch built in 69.He confirmed it was the cast iron pipes that corroded. I feel confident and he was very knowledgeable for what I need to do next. The company was great punctual on time and friendly recommend them highly

So our mortgage insurance policy was recently switched to a different company via our broker. The new company required that a home inspector come out and look at our property. Everything seemed to go fine. A day later we got a 39 page report with their findings. They were threatening to drop our new policy saying we had a “water leak at the property” and they included a picture. I looked at the picture and there is a small water mark on the tile floor behind my 1/2 bath pedestal sink. Are you se

Josh came to fix a leaky faucet and clear our bathtub drain, and he did an outstanding job. He explained everything clearly, and worked efficiently. Polite, professional, and knowledgeable — I’d highly recommend him for any plumbing needs.

Had some trouble with my water heater yesterday afternoon.  Tried to diagnose the problem myself but reached out to Mother Modern for assistance. They were here this morning and fixed the issue.  Josh is very knowledgeable and offers solid advice on all of your plumbing needs.  Reach out to Mother Modern plumbing and ask about their membership options.

If you are looking for professional plumbing company look no further than Mother's modern plumbing. These guys truly care about their clients and the service they offer. I want to give a shout out to Mario Cabrera for taking out our 66 year old clay pipes and updating with new pipes shout out to Tyler the guy who was able to make this possible for us. You will not be disappointed in this company and their work. Check them out!!!

We needed a toilet replaced. Called Mother! This was our first experience with them. Excellent communications and customer service! Scheduling was easy, gave a 2-hour window for arrival, and Josh  arrived on time for both visits;  was very professional.  During the install he took care not to damage floor/walls and did a great job. Highly recommend this company!

If you need a plumber in Dallas this is exactly who you want to use. They are efficient, on time, and always so kind. The communication is amazing and you never have to wonder when they’ll show up. We have referred several friends to them and everyone always raves about the results. They also clean up their messes and don’t leave you in a position where on top of the inconvenience of having something in your home go wrong you then have to deal with a giant mess. They are truly the best. 100% rec

Descaled Tankless water heater. Professionally attired, knowledgeable, efficient, no mess, no fuss, friendly. Job took 20 minutes, with no hot water. Mother Plumbing is the only plumber I use from feeding kitchen faucet hose back through faucet to rerouting gas line to pool furnace from underground to taking feed from attice branch and installing pressure regulators on all other gas appliances. These plumbers are professional and competent. A++

Really pleased with our work through Mother Modern plumbing. Josh was great and easy to work with. Initially there was a misunderstanding, but they more than fixed it, worked with me on scheduling and even checked on me after a planned surgery! Will definitely be using them again!

Had a water heater that needed replacing. Joe and Brian showed up at 5PM and stuck around until the job was done. We were able to give our daughter a bath that night thanks to them. Install was 6 days ago, and so far there’s no indication that our house will flood or explode, which we also appreciate. Thanks y’all!

We had issues with hot and cold water. Joe and Luke diagnosed it very quickly, picked up the part and got the job done. They also installed a new faucet in the kitchen. All work was very professional, quick and reasonably priced. We were very pleased.

Dillon Ashton helped us out today and did a great job presenting the necessary info without up-selling. He was super nice and really informative on the issue we were dealing with. I’ve worked with him and Steven off and on for years and have always appreciated their honesty, reasonable prices, good work, and responsive communication. Thank y’all!

Josh with Mother Modern Plumbing was excellent at explaining every step of the way in getting our kitchen sink backup fixed. He was very attentive and knowledgeable in his approach of getting to the problem. He answered every question with ease and was able to solve the problem!
We even decided to join the membership because of his great work! Thank you for your customer service, Josh.

Edited*
Originally gave 4 stars upgraded to 5. Not from a bad experience but more or less just misconception due to services/pricing. Overall great company, the plumber was great showed up on time and was efficient and confident in his work (which I value). Customer service was even better the company reached out after the apt and asked about things we went over pricing and realized their was a correction to be made so to say and they insisted on adjusting the price for me.  Im not really used t

Matthew did a great job! I was very happy with Matthew’s analysis of my situation. He was able to replace my old cast iron plumbing that was causing our kitchen sink to not drain properly. Once he reconfigured the plumbing, replacing it with PVC, he was able to see that the rest of the line was in good shape which saved me some money. I appreciate the quick response, professionalism and honesty of the entire team!
Dillon Ashton came over to fix a leak in our backyard. He was professional, nice and friendly. He got the work done quickly and efficiently. Highly recommended!

I have had issues over the past 5 years or so and had several plumbers tell me different things and gotten some very different quotes. Tyler came out today and explained the whole situation better than any of the other plumbing companies. He did what he could for what I can afford today but he left me with 3 different quotes and options for me think about. Once I figure out my plans with this house I will definitely call Mothers Plumbing.

Great company. My favorite part is their good communication practices which are hard to find in today's world. Great service provided by Tyler and Melvin. Did a good job being flexible with my ever changing schedule and doing an in depth analysis of my issues and explaining numerous options that could fix the problems faced. Completely satisfied with the services received. Would recommend them to anyone and will use them again in the future

Our water heater went out. They can out quickly and gave me a quote. Mario came out and installed the water heater. He was so great. I will always choose Mothers. Not just for the great price but because they really care. Thank you

WOW! I am so impressed! Mother's Modern Plumbing started with my phone call in and Patricia was so courteous and pleasant. That really helps when someone is frustrated with a plumbing issue. Technician Colton was prompt, pleasant, and professional. He explained the situation and what he would do to resolve the problem, which I agreed. My outside faucet wouldn't turn off and water kept running. Highly recommend Mother Modern Plumbing.

Dillon Ashton came to investigate a leak and give some estimates. He was professional and thorough. We haven’t decided who we go with yet, so I can’t comment more than that, but we appreciate the ease of scheduling and his work for the first visit.

Absolutely fantastic experience! Dillon was prompt, professional, and incredibly knowledgeable. He diagnosed the issue quickly, explained everything clearly, and had it fixed in no time. Courteous, efficient, and left everything spotless. Highly recommend!

I recently had Melvin Hill and Josh Dudley from Mother Modern Plumbing handle a residential plumbing project at my home, and I couldn’t be more impressed—easily a 5-star experience from start to finish! They arrived right on time, fully prepared, and his professionalism shone through immediately with their courteous demeanor and meticulous attention to detail. They walked me through every step of the process, explaining the “why” behind each valve and fitting in a way that was clear and easy to

Joe and Bryan were very professional and very efficient. We have a big home and it was a complicated repair and Leak Defense system installation. They were prompt, courteous, and a credit to the company. I had a great experience.

Dillon and his apprentice Steven did an AMAZING job and cleared my drain and much more professional than the last plumber that came out Saturday who couldn't fix my problem. And I got the red carpet treatment. Like they actually had red carpet laid out when I opened the door! They also cleaned my bathtub out that was dirty from the plumbing issues. Absolutely would recommend 1000%!!! 😊

Found water leak in wall. Called Mother and they sent Colton to find where the leak was located and he did a great job in finding it but he also found a toilet leaking    Then Matt brought they neede supplies and fixed both problems and cleaned up and everything is good shape now   Both technicians work very well and did a great job. Thanks for sending them so fast.

A quick shout out to Mathew van Hoy of Mother Modern Plumbing. Not only was he knowledgeable and methodical in assessing my drain issue, he was also a good listener and clear communicator. I appreciate Mathew for being focused on proposing the most reasonable fix. It was clear that my best interest was top-of-mind for him. Based on this experience, I’ll gladly recommend Mother Modern to my most trusted friends!

Dillon Ashton came out for an emergency call when a drain line from our laundry room was clogged.  He thoroughly assessed the situation, walked me through everything he was doing, and answered all of my questions giving me confidence the job was being done well.  Thank you, Dillon, and Mother Modern Plumbing for helping us respond to an emergency in our house, getting someone out here in about one hour from the time we called.

Steven did an amazing job replacing our kitchen faucet and bathroom sink. He communicated perfectly with us on what to expect. We purchased the new faucet and he replaced it the very next day. Steven was friendly, so much so that our kids enjoyed talking to him!  I’ll recommend Mother Modern Plumbing to everyone!

What a great company to work with. Called in the morning and Dillon Ashton came out that afternoon to install a new water valve for my refrigerator. Did a great job. Will use them again if I need plumbing work done.

We worked with Joe Stailey and he was amazing! We had to do a complete repipe in the house hoping it will help prevent future leaks. He always took the time to answer questions, arrived on time in the mornings, and overall this was the most positive interaction we have had with a plumbing company.

Dillon Ashton came out to help with a running toilet. He was able to give me many options to address my problem today or schedule a fix for a larger problem. He was professional, easy to talk to, and smart. I would be happy to see him listed as the technician on any future service call!

Dillon Ashton came in a timely manner and solved my plumbing issue quickly!  It was hot and he worked with a happy heart to perform a drain clearing on the main sewer line. Thanks, Modern Mother Plumbing.  We will definitely call again if needed.

Melvin Hill and crew did an awesome job taking care of all the things I had done. New toilet install, water heater replacement, and new house shut off valve. They got everything done in a day which was great for us. Would recommend.

I would highly recommend the team, starting with the Tyler who assessed the problem and gave me the best options for my budget. Mel, Reese and Jeremy did a perfect job installing everything I needed to avoid any future headaches with my plumbing! My throne has never been better! Thank you again!

I had an amazing experience with Mother Modern Plumbing! If you’re looking for a reliable plumber in Dallas, look no further. From start to finish, their communication was top-notch — I always felt informed and never left guessing. They were responsive, clear, and genuinely helpful throughout the entire process. The work was done efficiently and with great attention to detail. It’s rare to find a company this professional and easy to work with. Highly recommend!

Dillon Ashton did a wonderful job. He was timely, professional, kind, and was sure to explain his work and show me the results. Additionally, he took time to explain how I could prevent future issues. I highly recommend Dillon to anyone looking for a professional and efficient plumber.

Dillon Ashton was amazing.  He took his time and answered a bunch of questions about several different issues related to my high water bill and kitchen plumbing issues.  Now Ill get both issues fixed.  Great service from the start!
